Light Novel 'Tsuihou sareta Shounin wa Kane no Chikara de Sekai wo Sukuu' Gets TV Anime
Publishing company Shufu to Seikatsusha announced a television anime adaptation of Daken's Tsuihou sareta Shounin wa Kane no Chikara de Sekai wo Sukuu (The Exiled Merchant Saves the World with the Power of Gold) light novel on Friday. Daken began penning the fantasy novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in March 2023. 'The Ribbon Hero' Reveals Supporting Cast, Third Trailer
The official website of the The Ribbon Hero original anime movie revealed supporting cast and a third trailer on Thursday. The anime movie based on Osamu Tezuka's Ribbon no Kishi (Princess Knight) manga will premiere worldwide exclusively on Netflix on August 8. Additional Cast for 'Tenmaku no Jaadugar' Announced
The official website of the Tenmaku no Jaadugar (Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia) television anime announced additional cast ahead of episode 6 on Thursday. The anime series adapting Tomato Soup's historical drama manga premiered with a 60-minute special on July 4 at 11:00 p.m. on TV Asahi and its 24 affiliates' IMAnimation programming block, followed by BS Asahi.
